description: This file defines the interface PortfolioAccountReadPlatformService for reading portfolio account data, including methods to retrieve individual or collections of account data, possibly filtered by account ID, type, or currency.

classes.name: PortfolioAccountReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for retrieving portfolio account data, including specific account retrieval and lookup for collections.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a portfolio account data object based on account ID and account type ID.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a portfolio account data object based on account ID, account type ID, and currency code.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of portfolio account data objects based on a PortfolioAccountDTO filter.

methods.name: retrieveOneByPaidInAdvance
methods.description: Retrieves a portfolio account data object for accounts paid in advance, based on account ID and account type ID.
